div.head: I Cn 3.1
div.ab: Ne synd ealle cyricean na gelicre mæðe woruldlice wurðscipes wyrðe, þeah hig godcundlice habban halsunge gelice.
Ne synd ealle cyricean na gelicre mæðe wuruldlice weorðe, þeah hig godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
quia non omnes ęcclesię parem emendationis dignitatem habent, licet eandem sanctificationis benedictionem consequantur.
Ne synd ealle cyricean na gelicre mæðe woruldlice wurðscipes wyrðe, þeah hig godcundlice habban hal[g]unge gelice.
Ne synd ealle cyricean na gelicre mæðe woruldlice wurðscipes wyrðe, þeah hig godcundlice habban halgunge gelice.
Keineswegs sind alle Kirchen im bürgerlichen Recht gleichen Ranges theilhaftig (ehrenwerth G), obwohl sie kanonisch die Weihe (Gebetsbeschwörung G) gleich haben.
Not all churches are entitled to the same rank (of honour, G) in secular terms, although they have the same consecration (exorcism, G) in ecclesiastical terms.
Not all churches are to be regarded as possessing the same status in civil law, though from the side of religion they all possess the same sanctity.
Not all churches are considered alike in worldly status, although spiritually they all possess equal sanctity.
div.note: G's ‘wurðscipes’ is probably G's own addition; G's ‘halsunge’ should be corrected to ‘halgunge’ from the other MSS and VIII Atr 5. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 5.
